reasoning: Shows five solid vertical bars ascending monotonically from left to right, the classic UI glyph for full 5-bar cellular signal strength as well as a minimal rising bar chart. While derived from status-bar chrome, it fits real tasks around cellular coverage/boosters and growth statistics or charts, though it competes closely with chart icons that have axes and with Wi-Fi/antenna icons.
